sloka: अस्त्रे प्रतिहते क्रुद्धो रावणो राक्षसाधिपः ।अभ्यवर्षत्तदा रामं घोराभिः शरवृष्टिभिः ।। ६.१०३.२४ ।।
transliteration: astre pratihate kruddho rāvaṇo rākṣasādhipaḥ ।abhyavarṣattadā rāmaṁ ghorābhiḥ śaravṛṣṭibhiḥ ।। 6.103.24 ।।

translations.english: Flaming coils like the Vasuki, covering all quarters with poison, enveloped all over.
